note: Measured values come from the synthetic fixture demo run and are not benchmark results.

ambiguities.title: Temporal overlap of the final-10% slice with the 15% test split
ambiguities.repo: Measured and exported to late_slice_overlap.json; late slice is a subset of test here.

measured.interpretation: The late slice is the final 10% of rows in time; the test split is the final 15%. With these fractions the late slice is a strict subset of the test split, so late-slice metrics are NOT independent of test metrics. Measured, not assumed.

ambiguities.title: Calendar and entity availability in BAF (month only; no card/IP/device)
ambiguities.repo: BAF adapter uses month as the only chronological key and no entity graph.

ambiguities.title: Calibration sample count (100,000 stated vs 88,581 = 15% of IEEE-CIS)
ambiguities.repo: Calibrator is fitted on the validation split only; the count is whatever the split yields.

ambiguities.title: Routing rule: Eq. 5 (p < gamma_low and u < T_u) vs low/high band thresholds
ambiguities.repo: Both implemented behind routing.rule; default eq5; escalation shares under both are exported.

ambiguities.title: Fit scope of stacking and calibration (validation split vs pooled OOF)
ambiguities.repo: Both fitted on the 15% validation split, never on test; no pooled OOF.

ambiguities.title: Intersample attention leakage across rows
ambiguities.repo: Historical-context mask forbids attention to later timestamps; windows are chronological.

ambiguities.title: Out-of-fold target encoding scheme
ambiguities.repo: Expanding-window forward OOF on training rows; full-train statistics for val/test.

ambiguities.title: What the 1-D optimal transport calibration is
ambiguities.repo: Quantile matching of binned label rates with K knots and min support; isotonic as comparator.

ambiguities.title: Template search (MCTS with K=64 over 50,000 rows)
ambiguities.repo: Hand-written 16-template demo bank plus a small MCTS that appends a few templates.

ambiguities.title: Cost matrix units and values
ambiguities.repo: Demo cost matrix in configs/demo_costs.yaml; the paper does not state units.

ambiguities.title: Upstream substitutes (card key, graph features, FraudGT baseline)
ambiguities.repo: Community card key for IEEE-CIS; no graph features; no FraudGT; documented as not implemented.
